'''Robert Kutruff''' is credited on 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] as the source of the card image.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Set 10]], dated 2019 on this wiki. The credit on [[Luke Skywalker, The Last Jedi|•Luke Skywalker, The Last Jedi]] is shared with [[Card Credits#Jon Reino|Jon Reino]].
